caseName: Linda R. S. v. Richard D.
caseNameFull: Linda R. S. v. Richard D.

opinions.text: Appeal from D. C. N. D. Tex. [Probable jurisdiction postponed, 405 U. S. 1064.] Motion of appellant for appointment of counsel granted. It is ordered that Windle Turley, Esquire, of Dallas, Texas, a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for appellant in this case.
